eos.service: EOS conversational service (eos_service.py), fronted by the intake gateway at /api/eos/*; the gateway receipts every crossing, including refusals

implementing_surface.service: manifested intake service of ECOSYSTEM__CHAT__SPEC__01 (ecochat), extended with the endpoint idiom above and fronting the EOS conversational service
implementing_surface.seat: a binding, not a dependency: endpoint is configuration; an unreachable seat receipts and queues

client.mechanism: binding-driven: the page reads this file at load; the gateway route is used only when client_gateway_enabled is true and endpoint is named; any failure falls back to the filed device-local behavior

activation_claim: NONE - no live or activation claim is made from source, merge, or deployment alone; public observation governs.
